caseNameFull: McDaniel, Superintendent of Schools of Clarke County v. Barresi
judges: Arid, Black, From, Harlan, Marshall, Motion

opinions.text:
Sup. Ct. Ga. Certiorari granted and case set for oral argument immediately following No. 498 [probable jurisdiction noted, supra]. Motion of the State, of Georgia for leave . to participate in oral argument as amicus curiae denied.

The Chief Justice, Mr. Justice Black, Mr. Justice Harlan, arid Mr. Justice Marshall dissent from the denial of the motion.
